<!-- 
  Component: metatext.html
  The First Hyperstack Meta Component.
  Compound data field with a dominant Hero text/input flanked by up to 2 metadata cells above
  and 2 metadata cells below.
  Strict Guardrails:
    - 2x2 Cap: Maximum 2 cells Top, Maximum 2 cells Bottom.
    - 50% Typography Rule: Meta font size strictly 50% smaller than Hero text.
    - Graceful Fallback: Empty values render as clean em-dash ("—").
  Theme: 100% Pure Clean Light Theme Sitewide.
-->
<div class="space-y-10 font-sans text-slate-900" id="metatext-showcase-root">

  <!-- ======================================================================= -->
  <!-- TOP CONTROLLER: DUAL-TAB SELECTOR [Text Field] vs [MetaText Field]      -->
  <!-- ======================================================================= -->
  <div class="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-xs">
    <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
      <div>
        <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-slate-950 flex items-center gap-2">
          <span>✍️</span> Text Components (Light Theme)
        </h2>
        <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
          Unified documentation for standard Text Fields and Advanced MetaText Compound Fields.
        </p>
      </div>

      <!-- Tab Switcher -->
      <div class="inline-flex p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold select-none">
        <a href="/docs/components/text" 
           class="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md font-bold transition-all text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900">
          Text Field
        </a>
        <a href="/docs/components/text?tab=metatext" 
           class="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-md font-bold transition-all bg-white text-indigo-700 shadow-xs">
          MetaText Field
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ======================================================================= -->
  <!-- 1. STANDALONE CLINICAL IDENTITY BADGE (THE CANONICAL REFERENCE)        -->
  <!-- ======================================================================= -->
  <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs space-y-4">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
      <div>
        <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
          <span>🏷️</span> 1. Standalone MetaText Badge (Reference Display)
        </h3>
        <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">High-density biometric coordinate card with 50% typography scaling.</p>
      </div>
      <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-teal-50 text-teal-700 border border-teal-200">
        READ-ONLY BADGE
      </span>
    </div>

    <div class="flex flex-col gap-6 p-4 bg-slate-50/50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
      
      <!-- 1:1 Footprint Comparison: Simple Textbox vs Advanced MetaText -->
      <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-200">
        <div>
          <span class="block text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-600 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5 font-bold">Standard Regular Textbox (h-10 / 40px)</span>
          <input type="text" 
                 value="David Jeba" 
                 readonly 
                 class="h-10 w-full rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white px-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 shadow-2xs focus:outline-none" />
          <p class="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">Single simple text string. Zero metadata capacity.</p>
        </div>

        <div>
          <span class="block text-[11px] font-mono text-indigo-700 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5 font-bold">Advanced MetaText Field (Exact Same h-10 / 40px Footprint!)</span>
          <!-- Ultra-Compact MetaText Component (Zero Gap, 50% typography ratio) -->
          <div class="hs-metatext inline-flex flex-col justify-between h-10 w-full rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white shadow-2xs overflow-hidden select-none">
            <!-- TOP TIER (h-[11px], text-[8px], leading-none) -->
            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 divide-x divide-slate-200 border-b border-slate-200 text-[8px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0 h-[11px] items-center leading-none">
              <span class="text-slate-600 font-bold">UHID</span>
              <span class="text-right font-bold text-slate-900 tabular-nums">1221</span>
            </div>

            <!-- HERO MAIN TIER (h-[18px], text-sm, leading-none) -->
            <div class="px-2 py-0 flex items-center h-[18px] bg-white leading-none">
              <span class="text-sm font-black text-slate-950 tracking-tight block truncate">
                Pt - David Jeba
              </span>
            </div>

            <!-- BOTTOM TIER (h-[11px], text-[8px], leading-none) -->
            <div class="grid grid-cols-2 divide-x divide-slate-200 border-t border-slate-200 text-[8px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0 h-[11px] items-center leading-none">
              <span class="truncate"><span class="text-slate-500">AGE -</span> <strong class="text-red-600 font-bold">45</strong></span>
              <span class="truncate pl-1"><span class="text-slate-500">SEX -</span> <strong class="text-slate-900">Male</strong></span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p class="text-[10px] text-indigo-600 mt-1">✓ Drops 1:1 into standard input slots with zero vertical expansion.</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Spec Notation Callout -->
      <div class="p-4 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200 font-mono text-xs text-slate-700 space-y-2">
        <div class="text-[11px] text-indigo-700 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider font-sans">Shorthand Specification</div>
        <code class="text-indigo-900 font-bold text-[11px] block bg-white p-2 rounded border border-slate-200">
          MetaTextField("UHID: 1221 | [Pt - David Jeba] | AGE: 45!red, SEX: Male")
        </code>
        <p class="text-[11px] text-slate-600 font-sans leading-relaxed">
          Ultra-compact compound field: packs UHID, Age, and Sex metadata into the exact 40px vertical budget of a single text box. No wasted padding, 0 gap, 50% typography ratio strictly enforced.
        </p>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ======================================================================= -->
  <!-- 2. IN A FORM: PATIENT ADMISSION & TRIAGE INTAKE FORM                    -->
  <!-- ======================================================================= -->
  <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs space-y-4">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
      <div>
        <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
          <span>📋</span> 2. In a Form: Editable MetaText with HTMX Auto-Save
        </h3>
        <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">The hero slot functions as an active form input while metadata coordinates persist.</p>
      </div>
      <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200">
        FORM INPUT MODE
      </span>
    </div>

    <form class="p-5 bg-slate-50/50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 space-y-4 max-w-xl"
          hx-post="/api/patients/save"
          hx-trigger="submit, change delay:400ms"
          hx-swap="none">

      <div class="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">Patient Primary Identity Cell:</div>

      <!-- ULTRA-COMPACT EDITABLE METATEXT FORM COMPONENT (Matches standard h-10 textbox) -->
      <div class="hs-metatext flex flex-col justify-between h-10 w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded shadow-2xs text-slate-900 font-sans overflow-hidden focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-indigo-500 focus-within:border-indigo-500 transition-all select-none">
        
        <!-- TOP ROW: READ-ONLY SYSTEM METADATA (h-[11px], text-[8px], leading-none) -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 divide-x divide-slate-200 border-b border-slate-200 text-[8px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0 h-[11px] items-center leading-none">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span class="text-slate-500">UHID:</span>
            <input type="hidden" name="uhid" value="1221" />
            <span class="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900">#1221</span>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
            <span class="text-slate-500">TRIAGE:</span>
            <span class="font-bold text-amber-600 font-mono">LEVEL 2</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- HERO MAIN ROW: LIVE FORM TEXT INPUT (h-[18px], text-sm, leading-none) -->
        <div class="px-2 py-0 flex items-center h-[18px] bg-white leading-none">
          <span class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-400 select-none mr-1">Pt -</span>
          <input type="text"
                 name="pt_name"
                 value="David Jeba"
                 placeholder="Enter patient full name..."
                 class="w-full text-sm font-bold text-slate-950 bg-transparent border-0 p-0 m-0 leading-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 placeholder:text-slate-400" />
        </div>

        <!-- BOTTOM ROW: EDITABLE MICRO-COORDINATES (h-[11px], text-[8px], leading-none) -->
        <div class="grid grid-cols-2 divide-x divide-slate-200 border-t border-slate-200 text-[8px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0 h-[11px] items-center leading-none">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
            <span class="text-slate-500">AGE:</span>
            <input type="number" 
                   name="age" 
                   value="45" 
                   class="w-8 font-bold text-red-600 bg-transparent border-none p-0 m-0 text-[8px] leading-none focus:outline-none" />
            <span class="text-slate-400">YRS</span>
          </div>
          <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
            <span class="text-slate-500">SEX:</span>
            <select name="sex" class="bg-transparent font-bold text-slate-900 border-0 p-0 m-0 text-[8px] leading-none focus:outline-none cursor-pointer">
              <option value="Male" selected>Male</option>
              <option value="Female">Female</option>
              <option value="Other">Other</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      <!-- Action Strip -->
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between pt-2">
        <span class="text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>
          HTMX Auto-saves on input blur or value change
        </span>
        <button type="submit" 
                class="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold text-xs transition-colors shadow-xs">
          Save Patient
        </button>
      </div>

    </form>
  </div>

          <!-- ROW 3: UNALLOCATED / EMPTY BED (GRACEFUL FALLBACK) -->

            <td class="px-4 py-3">

                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 divide-x divide-slate-300/60 border-b border-slate-300/60 text-[8px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0 h-[11px] items-center leading-none">

                <div class="grid grid-cols-2 divide-x divide-slate-300/60 text-[8px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider border-t border-slate-300/60 px-2 py-0 h-[11px] items-center leading-none">
                  <div class="truncate">AGE: —</div>
                  <div class="truncate pl-1">SEX: —</div>

            <!-- Attending Physician Fallback MetaText -->
            <td class="px-4 py-3">

                <div class="border-b border-slate-300/60 text-[8px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0 h-[11px] flex items-center leading-none">
                  <span>[DEPT: —]</span>

                <div class="px-2 py-0 flex items-center h-[18px] leading-none">

                </div>
                <div class="border-t border-slate-300/60 text-[8px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0 h-[11px] flex items-center leading-none">
                  <span>[Degree: —]</span>

            <!-- Admit Date Fallback MetaText -->

  <!-- 4. DYNAMIC REACIVITY: HxBOLT SIGNALS LIVE CONTROLLER                    -->
  <!-- ======================================================================= -->
  <div class="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-xs space-y-4"
       hx-state="{ uhid: '1221', name: 'David Jeba', age: 45, sex: 'Male' }">
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-100 pb-3">
      <div>
        <h3 class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2">
          <span>⚡</span> 4. Dynamic Client-Side Reactive State (HxBolt Signals)
        </h3>
        <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">Edit the fields below to see the MetaText component react in real time.</p>
      </div>
      <span class="px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border border-amber-200">
        HxBolt LIVE SIGNAL
      </span>
    </div>

    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 items-center p-4 bg-slate-50/50 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
      
      <!-- Interactive Signal Controllers -->
      <div class="space-y-3 font-mono text-xs">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
          <label class="w-16 text-slate-500 font-bold">UHID:</label>
          <input type="text" hx-model="uhid" class="flex-1 bg-white border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-slate-900 font-mono text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-600 shadow-2xs" />
        </div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
          <label class="w-16 text-slate-500 font-bold">Name:</label>
          <input type="text" hx-model="name" class="flex-1 bg-white border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-slate-900 font-mono text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-600 shadow-2xs" />
        </div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
          <label class="w-16 text-slate-500 font-bold">Age:</label>
          <input type="number" hx-model="age" class="w-24 bg-white border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-slate-900 font-mono text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-600 shadow-2xs" />
        </div>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
          <label class="w-16 text-slate-500 font-bold">Sex:</label>
          <select hx-model="sex" class="flex-1 bg-white border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-slate-900 font-mono text-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-600 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer">
            <option value="Male">Male</option>
            <option value="Female">Female</option>
            <option value="Other">Other</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Reactive MetaText Sink (Ultra-Compact h-10) -->
      <div class="flex justify-center w-full">
        <div class="hs-metatext inline-flex flex-col justify-between h-10 w-full max-w-[280px] bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded shadow-2xs text-slate-900 font-sans select-none overflow-hidden">
          <div class="grid grid-cols-[3fr_7fr] divide-x divide-slate-200 border-b border-slate-200 text-[8px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0 h-[11px] items-center leading-none bg-slate-50">
            <div class="text-slate-600 truncate">UHID</div>
            <div class="font-mono font-bold text-slate-900 text-right truncate" hx-text="uhid">1221</div>
          </div>
          <div class="px-2 py-0 flex items-center h-[18px] bg-white leading-none">
            <span class="text-sm font-bold text-slate-950 block truncate">
              Pt - <span hx-text="name">David Jeba</span>
            </span>
          </div>
          <div class="grid grid-cols-2 divide-x divide-slate-200 border-t border-slate-200 text-[8px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0 h-[11px] items-center leading-none bg-slate-50">
            <div class="truncate">
              <span class="text-slate-500">AGE -</span>
              <span class="font-bold text-red-600 font-mono" hx-text="age">45</span>
            </div>
            <div class="truncate pl-1">
              <span class="text-slate-500">SEX -</span>
              <span class="font-bold text-slate-900" hx-text="sex">Male</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
